Baked apple cottage cheese

Túrós sütemény

8 months+ Replaced 35 min 6 portions

Serve warm in soft spoonfuls. The apple is the only sweetness.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 250 g Cottage cheese (Pasteurized)
  • 1 Egg (Baked until set)
  • 30 g Fine semolina (Wheat)
  • 1 small Eating apple (Peeled and grated)

Allergens

milkegggluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mash the cottage cheese with the egg and semolina.
  3. Stir in the grated apple.
  4. Spread in a small dish.
  5. Bake until the egg is set and the top is still soft, about 25 minutes.
  6. Cool slightly and spoon into bowls.

Replaced

The usual sweet cheese bake is full of sugar. That sweetness is left out.

Bake pasteurized cottage cheese with egg, a little semolina, and grated apple. Add no sugar.
